subject: make net_input_bytes_curr_cmd more readable (#1756)
reason: The change is a pure readability refactor of how net_input_bytes_curr_cmd is accumulated in processMultibulkBuffer, plus comment updates. The old total (multibulklen_slen+1) + Σ bulklen_slen + (argv_len_sum + argc*5 + 2) and the new total (multibulklen_slen+3) + Σ (bulklen_slen+3) + (argv_len_sum + argc*2) are algebraically identical for every command shape, each accumulation site executes the same number of times as before, and the only consumers (CLUSTER SLOT-STATS network-bytes-in and the large-request commandlog) read the counter only after parsing completes, so no observable behaviour cha
